_note: The academic-register candidate list. This file is the deterministic pipeline's interface to Google Drive: a Claude session drops each doc to corpus/data/gdocs/<fileId>.md via the Drive connector, and corpus/harvest-drive.ts reads the manifest plus those files. Keeping MCP out of the pipeline makes the build replayable and testable offline.
_authorship: `authorship` is set ONLY by Colin, through the CORPUS_AUTHORSHIP_UNVERIFIED checkpoint. No heuristic may promote a document. `unverified` and `unsure` both stay quarantined; only `colin_wrote_it` enters the corpus.
_triageHint: `hint` is advisory only — a fast read of whether the text looks hand-written or LLM-generated. It orders the triage queue; it never decides it.
